walkthroughs.title: Signing in twice

moments.say: Alice signs in; she has exactly this one session.
She tries to sign in a second time while still signed in, and is turned away.

walkthroughs.goal: Alice wants to use the service and then leave it.

walkthroughs.title: Locked out while signed in

moments.say: A wrong password is tried on her account.
A fourth. The account is still open.
The fifth wrong password locks the account and ends her session.
Alice tries to sign in again and is turned away.

walkthroughs.goal: Someone tries wrong passwords on Alice's account while she is signed in.

walkthroughs.title: Left idle

moments.say: And more: she has now been idle for three time units, and is still signed in.
That is not yet long enough for the session to expire.
Back at her desk, Alice signs in again.

walkthroughs.goal: Alice signs in and then walks away from her desk.

journeys.title: Signing in and out
journeys.goal: A user wants to use the service and then leave it.

journeys.title: Wrong passwords lock an account

steps.say: A wrong password is tried on the account; the fifth one locks it.

journeys.goal: Someone keeps trying wrong passwords on an account; the account is locked until an administrator opens it again.

journeys.title: A session left idle expires

steps.say: Time passes with nothing happening in the session.

journeys.goal: A user signs in and walks away; the service ends the session by itself.

code.verdict: the code agrees with the model on every journey and walkthrough, and on every transition and refusal within 7 steps of the start (9844 transitions, 100015 code steps)
code.setup:
from app.auth import AuthService
class Clock:
    now = 0
    def tick(self):
        self.now += 1
clock = Clock()
system = AuthService(lambda: clock.now)

assumptions: Two users (alice, bob) and two sessions (s1, s2) stand for any number of them.
Time is counted in ticks while a session is idle; the search stops one tick past the session timeout, so nothing is claimed about what happens long after a session expired.
Checking the password is outside the model: a login arrives already known to be right or wrong.
